ar: وَيَا خَافِضُ اخْفِضْ لِي الْقُلُوْبَ تَحَبُّبًا
tr: Wa Yā Rāfi`u ‘rfa` dhikranā wa` ‘li qadranā
en: O Abaser, humble hearts to me with caress – O Exalter, exalt our mention and raise our status

tr: Wa dhallil bi ṣafwin Yā Mudhillu nufūsanā
en: With devotion and piety, Honorer, honor us – Humble our egos in serenity, O Degrader

tr: Wa naffidh bi ḥaqqin Yā Samī`u maqālatī
Wa baṣṣir fu’ādī Yā Baṣīru bi `aybinā
en: Execute with appropriateness, O All Hearing, my statements – Enlighten my heart, O All Seeing, to my faults

tr: Wa Yā Ḥakamun Yā `Adlu ḥakkim qulūbanā
en: O Judge, O Just, rule over our hearts – With justice in all things and empower us with rationality

ar: وَ تَوِّجْهُمُوْ بِالنُّوْرِ كَيْ يُدْرِكُوا الْمُنَى
tr: Wa ḥuffa bi luṭfin Yā Laṭīfu aḥibbatī
Wa tawwij humū bi ‘n-nūri kay yudriku ‘l-munā
en: Surround us with gentleness, O Gentle, my Love – Crown them with light to reach what they long for
